title: Key West Sunset Sail with Open Bar, Live Music and Hors D'oeuvres
includes: Dual spacious bathrooms for guest comfort
Open liquor bar, champagne, sangria, boutique wine, premium beer, and cocktails
Live music from local Key West musicians
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Minimum age to drink alcohol is 21 years
policies: Please arrive 30 minutes prior to your scheduled departure time.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Admire an exquisitely painted sky during this premium sunset cruise in Key West. Create fantastic memories as you set sail on one of Sebago's modern sailing catamarans while sipping sparkling wine or your favorite cocktail and feasting on shrimp cocktail on your way to the best sunset viewing spot. You'll enjoy twilight views of the island as you watch the famous Key West sunset from the water. 

Now featuring live music from local Key West Musicians!
